entry.title: Social Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Bot Screen launch dominates the week. The clear headline is Hermes Desktop's Bot Screen feature: @NousResearch's official announcement (top post, highest engagement in batch) and @Teknium's companion launch of live desktop passthrough (173k views, 1.1k+ likes) let users watch agent sessions stream in real time and take over the agent's machine interactively. Official onboarding moved fast — @NousResearch distributed @tonbistudio's walkthrough (44k views) and @Teknium amplified the guide video — with community reactions like "Finallllly!" signaling a long-awaited feature. Jev × OMH ecosystem tooling: @rlaope drove the biggest builder updates, shipping oh-my-hermes (OMH) support for Jev-Skills, Model Routing, aliases and plugins, plus the open-source jeval tool for Jev evaluation and visualization (a near-duplicate jeval post was deduped out of the top list). Core-team support: @Teknium stayed hands-on — rebutting a plugin cache-bug claim, confirming a quick community-reported fix, and clarifying the new tooling is Nous-built, not Anthropic's. Community sentiment: practical guidance (use Hermes via iMessage with any model) and a timely take that Claude Opus 5.5 (GA'd the day before coverage) is "crazy" but Claude Code lags — read as quiet confidence in Hermes Agent. Low-signal chatter (emoji-only replies, link-only promos, "drop your GitHub" prompts) was excluded from the top ranking.
